span.p:
Redis + Read replica
har 2 sec haal, DB ghira
-> GET /status: Redis me? wahin se, nahi -> read replica, phir Redis me rakho
(cache + replica)
worker ne DONE likha -> DB + Redis saath
har 2 sec poochna -> gap badhao 2s, 4s, 8s (backoff)
Redis gira -> replica pe seedha + rate limit
